title: Long Ivy-Covered Boundary Hedge, Near Bishopsbourne
summary: A long ivy-covered boundary hedge near Bishopsbourne, taken back in stages with the ivy thinned and the base tidied.

title: Leaning evergreen hedge brought back to a clean line, Patrixbourne
summary: A leaning evergreen hedge in Patrixbourne cut back to an upright, clean line with a levelled top and a lawn that can be mown to the edge.
